秦书简慌张的抓住了他乱动的手。颤着声音拒绝：“不要……”程安的手指顺势穿过她的指缝，十指相扣。另一只手滑到她的腰间，霸道的扣住了她的腰，她整个人都被他锁到了怀中，动弹不得。秦书简轻轻的挣了一下，没挣开，怯怯的抬头朝他看去。程安的唇“啪”的砸在了她的眼角。她微微颤动的睫毛扫过他的唇，痒痒的。“不要什么？”他像是发现了什么好玩的事情，唇角蹭过她颤动的睫毛，最后又落在她在唇上。气息缠的太近，她紧张的闭着眼睛，屏住了呼吸，一动也不敢动，只有被他唇角蹭过的睫毛，还在轻轻的颤着，像是抖动的小勾子，勾人的紧。程安却没有进一步的动作，反而是往后稍稍退了些。秦书简察觉到他的动作，眼睛小心翼翼的掀开一条缝儿，然后生怕他发现似的，又慌慌张张的闭上了。程安感觉自己的喉咙都在微微发烫，出口的声音也带上了一点哑，“小简单，我这个人很好说话的。”秦书简眼皮动了动，轻眨了一下，才悄悄的睁开眼，小声“嗯？”了一声。程安抽出一根手指在她掌心轻挠了一下，“你亲我一下，我就放开你。”“不然我帮你换的话，我可不保证这午饭还能不能吃了……”秦书简惊慌的瞪大了眼睛。程安努力的扯平了自己几乎压不下来的唇角，装的一脸高冷的盯着她。秦书简咽了口唾沫，有点害怕。但是她一点也不想让他给她换衣服……她在心底给自己鼓了鼓气，忍辱负重的闭上了眼睛，朝他唇上慢吞吞的凑去，在快要靠近他的时候，她忍不住小声问了句，“真的就一下就行吗？”程安低着头，盯着她近在咫尺的唇，眼底的火烧的更烫了。原本是行的。但是现在，恐怕是有点不行了。不过为了让自己看起来也不是那么无耻，他还是义正言辞的回了句，“你想亲两下也可以。”秦书简吓的身子一颤，然后飞快的凑过去在他唇上轻轻的碰了一下，就退开了。只是刚刚退开，他的唇就重重的压了上来，逼得她无处可躲，再次沉溺在他的气息中。秦书简挣扎着“呜咽”了几声，只听他喘着气，咬着她的耳垂说，“小简单，我们礼尚往来啊！”…这顿午饭到底还是迟了许久，不过吃牛排的时候，程安难得十分贴心的给她把牛排切成了一小块一小块的，放到了她的面前，然后又是递汤又是递水果的，殷勤的很。让原本就心惊胆战的秦书简越发的胆战心惊起来。他该不会是想要喂饱了她以后再次吃干抹净吧？秦书简想着，默默放下了没喝完的半碗汤。程安正叉了一颗草莓递到了她的唇边，见她放下了勺子，笑着问，“怎么不吃了？”秦书简心说，我不敢吃啊！但是嘴上还是只敢用我吃饱了来应付一下。只是她刚发出了一个“我”字，一颗草莓就被他整个塞进了她嘴里。对面那只程·狐狸精·安，目光扫着她锁骨上的红痕，懒洋洋的出声，“草莓，很好吃的~”-求月票哦~

Qin Shujian panicked and grabbed his moving hand. He refused with a trembling voice: "No..." Cheng An's fingers passed through her fingers smoothly and intertwined their fingers. The other hand slid to her waist and clasped her waist domineeringly. Her whole body was locked in his arms, unable to move. Qin Shujian struggled slightly but did not move away. She timidly raised her head and looked at him. Cheng An's lips slammed into the corner of her eye. Her slightly trembling eyelashes swept across his lips, tickling him. "What don't you want?" He seemed to have discovered something interesting. The corner of his lips brushed against her trembling eyelashes, and finally fell on her lips again. The breath was so close that she closed her eyes nervously, held her breath, and did not dare to move. Only the eyelashes that had been brushed by the corner of his lips were still trembling slightly, like small trembling hooks, so attractive. Cheng An made no further moves, but stepped back slightly. Qin Shujian noticed his movement, carefully opened his eyes a crack, and then closed them in a panic as if he was afraid that he would find out. Cheng An felt that his throat was slightly hot, and his voice was a little hoarse, "Xiao Jianjian, I am easy to talk to." Qin Shujian's eyelids moved, he blinked lightly, then quietly opened his eyes and whispered "Huh?" Cheng An took out a finger and scratched her palm lightly, "Kiss me and I'll let you go." "Otherwise, if I change it for you, I'm not sure whether you can still eat this lunch..." Qin Shujian's eyes widened in panic. Cheng An tried his best to flatten the corners of his lips that could barely be suppressed, and stared at her with a cold look on his face. Qin Shujian swallowed, a little scared. But she didn't want him to change her clothes at all... She cheered herself up in her heart, closed her eyes with humiliation, and slowly moved towards his lips. When she was about to get close to him, she couldn't help but whisper, "Is it really just a moment?" Cheng An lowered his head and stared at her lips so close, the fire in his eyes became even hotter. Originally it was OK. But now, I'm afraid it's a bit difficult. However, in order to make himself not look so shameless, he still replied righteously, "You can kiss him twice if you want." Qin Shujian trembled with fright, then quickly leaned over and touched his lips lightly, and then backed away. Just as she pulled away, his lips pressed heavily against her, forcing her to have nowhere to hide and to indulge in his breath again. Qin Shujian struggled and whimpered a few times, only to hear him panting, biting her earlobe and saying, "Xiao Jian, let's reciprocate politely!"... After all, lunch was still a long time late, but when eating steak, Cheng An was very considerate and cut the steak into small pieces for her, put it in front of her, and then served soup and fruit, very attentive. This made Qin Shujian, who was already frightened, even more frightened. Could it be that he wanted to eat her clean again after feeding her? Qin Shujian thought and silently put down the unfinished half bowl of soup. Cheng Anzheng forked a strawberry and handed it to her lips. Seeing her put down the spoon, he asked with a smile, "Why don't you eat it?" Qin Shujian said to her heart, I don't dare to eat it! But I still only dare to cope with it by saying that I am full. But as soon as she said the word "I", he stuffed a whole strawberry into her mouth. The vixen Cheng An on the opposite side glanced at the red marks on her collarbone and said lazily, "Strawberries, they are delicious~" - Please vote for me~
